colorImport.title: Import colours from Excel
colorImport.description: Upload a spreadsheet with a header row containing a RAL code column (e.g. "Code" or "RAL") and a hex column (e.g. "Hex" or "Colour"). If the file has multiple sheets (e.g. it also has Brand/Catalogue/Profile sheets for the Systems import), name this one "Colors"/"Colours" — otherwise the first sheet is used. New codes are added; an existing code only updates when its hex actually changed. Duplicate rows for the same code are collapsed automatically.
colorImport.noChanges: Nothing to import — the sheet matched what's already here.

systemsImport.description: Upload a spreadsheet with up to three sheets named exactly "Brand", "Catalogue", and "Profile" — any of the three can be left out. Brand: a "Name" column. Catalogue: "Brand", "Name", "System type", "Max glass thickness", "Max sash weight" — Brand must match a name from the Brand sheet. Profile: "Catalogue", "Profile no.", "Profile type", "Max glass thickness", "Weight", "Perimeter", "Inertia Ix", "Inertia Iy", an optional "Image", and an optional "Fly screen" (yes/no, defaults to no if left out) — Catalogue must match a name from the Catalogue sheet. Existing rows only update when a value actually changed.
